sin.name: file-read-in-a-listener
sin.description: A commit listener scans files or asks the skill catalogue to scan them.
sin.rule: Read file declarations when they change and supply the held declarations to listeners. The skill catalogue's plugin_skills is reached from skill listeners and is checked too: it lists a skill folder only through SkillCatalogue.listed_skill_files, which runs again only when the folder's version changes. BypassLogListener consumes and removes a new log written by the external Go hook, so reading that new input is required.
